title: Staged Rollout Plan

health_criteria: update install success >= 99% of attempted upgrades
signature_check Valid on every downloaded artifact
no data-integrity findings from integrity_scan jobs
disk_space_check and resume/retry success on real network paths
zero open P0/P1 regression in release ledger
stop_conditions: rollback trigger hit in canary not yet cleared
any stop condition from canary recurs twice

health_criteria: hosted CI green on release tag (or documented UNVERIFIABLE boundary)
download channel labels and checksums match the rc.1 manifest
stop_conditions: any regression reopened from fixed state
signature or checksum mismatch on the public channel
rollback_channel activation fails its switch-back check

approval_note: Choirudin explicitly approved the 113.44 staged rollout; execution is authorized subject to each stage's health criteria and stop conditions.
limits: Exposure percentages model audience shares; no telemetry pipeline has been verified to report these health criteria yet (hosted metrics UNVERIFIABLE)
Duration windows start only after explicit approval and a signed GA artifact exists on the channel
Rollback owner is a single named accountable human by design — no contest/incentive coupling (pilot-kit rule analog applies to rollout: approval is Choi's, not automated)
